name: check-bypass-guard
description: Hook that denies git hook and signing bypasses (--no-verify, commit -n, --no-gpg-sign, core.hooksPath overrides or git config changes, SKIP=) and asks before edits to existing lint, format and pre-commit configs or their ignore files, git hooks and .git/config, and Bash writes to those configs. Needs bun.

enabled.title: Enable the guard
enabled.description: Off removes the guard: --no-verify, commit -n, --no-gpg-sign, core.hooksPath changes and SKIP= are no longer denied, and edits to lint, format and hook configs, git hooks and .git/config no longer ask, so your permission rules decide. Only an exact false turns it off.
